    <!-- Script to assemble and submit product -->
    <script src="assemble_product.js"></script>

<script>
        // In a real implementation, this would handle the form submission
        document.getElementById('save-button').addEventListener('click', function() {
            // Ensure we have the latest global values
            const auth = window.productAuthenticity || '';
            const item = window.productItem || '';
            const origin = window.productOrigin || '';
            const price = window.listPrice || '';
            
            // Assemble the product name
            const assembledName = auth + ' ' + item + ' ' + origin;
            
            // Fill the form fields if they haven't been filled yet
            const nameInput = document.querySelector('input[name="product[name]"]');
            const priceInput = document.querySelector('input[name="product[price]"]');
            
            if (nameInput && !nameInput.value) {
                nameInput.value = assembledName;
            }
            
            if (priceInput && !priceInput.value) {
                priceInput.value = price;
            }
            
            const productName = document.querySelector('input[name="product[name]"]').value;
            const productPrice = document.querySelector('input[name="product[price]"]').value;
            
            console.log('Product Name:', productName);
            console.log('Product Price:', productPrice);
            console.log('Global Variables:');
            console.log('- Authenticity:', auth);
            console.log('- Item:', item);
            console.log('- Origin:', origin);
            console.log('- Stock Level:', window.stockLevel);
            console.log('- List Price:', price);
            
            alert('Product would be saved with name: ' + productName + ' and price: $' + productPrice);
        });
    </script>
